* Various link types

Regular link: [[https://example.com][Example]]

Link without description: [[https://example.com]]

File link: [[file:./other.org][Other file]]

Internal link: [[*Some Heading][heading link]]

Custom ID link: [[#my-id][by custom id]]

Fuzzy link: [[Some target]]

Image link: [[file:image.png]]

* Some Heading
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: my-id
:END:

This is the target heading.

<<Some target>>

This paragraph has a radio target.
